nom: Clinique Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Face Cream

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are split: several describe redness, bumps, or breakouts after use (including two who had never reacted to Clinique before), while others with sensitive or very sensitive/dry skin say it is gentle, non-stinging, and a keeper.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin generally report good hydration and a plumping effect, though one with dry skin also says it sits on top of the skin and feels dry rather than absorbing.
segments.combination: One reviewer describes combination skin in summer and says the product does not cause oiliness or redness and helps fine lines.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s-70s report smoother, firmer skin and reduced fine lines, with several long-term Clinique users calling it their best repurchase, though a few in this group see no real change in wrinkles.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers report visibly smoother, softer skin and reduced fine lines, sometimes within days to a few weeks; a minority say it is a good moisturizer but produced no real change in their wrinkles.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently describe the cream as hydrating, leaving skin plumped and moisturized overnight; one reviewer felt it stayed on top of the skin and left it feeling dry instead.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, mostly self-described sensitive skin, report new redness, blotchiness, or a burning/irritated feeling, including at the eye area; other sensitive-skin reviewers say it is non-stinging and causes no redness.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are mixed: several reviewers say it does not break them out even with acne-prone or breakout-prone skin, while others describe new red bumps, white pimples, or cystic-type breakouts starting within days of use.
concerns.oiliness: A few reviewers mention a slightly greasy or heavier feel on application, while others explicitly note the cream absorbs fully and leaves no greasy residue.

aspects.libelle: Feels heavy or sits on skin

extraits.texte: Have been using Clinique since my 20s - now in my 50s - sensitive skin with no issues. Used the Smart Night and Smart Day for years and loved them. For some reason they are discontinued and consultant recommended this - horrible experience with red bumps and white pimples all over my face. Bring back the old Smart Day with sunscreen and Smart Night. Now I need to find another brand for my sensitive skin.

Sensitive Skin Beware, I have extremely sensitive and dry skin. I have been using Clinique since my late teens. I am now 41. I have tried all types of skincare products and nothing works like Clinique. However, this particular Wrinkle repair cream was horrible. I used it at night before bed and woke up with the worst reaction. Red blotchy skin with bumps all over that were irritating. I have never had this type of reaction with Clinique products before. This was the first time. Just frustrating that I don't know what caused it. I called CS and sent it back.

I thought I'd try this along with the serum instead of my usual retinol product regimen. I'm sorry to say, it was a waste of money for me. Within 2 days my face began to break out like a teenager... which hasn't happened to me in over 40 years. It leaves a bit of a greasy feeling to it. Maybe good for some but not me.

I received a pretty good size sample of this and have since bought the full size. I repurchased just based on the fact that this cream felt so good in my routine and seem to be smoothing out my skin right away. I have very, very sensitive skin that is dry and so I can't really use a lot of products, but this works for me. I can see a lift after using it for about 3 weeks and my skin is smoother and most of the wrinkles are gone. I'm really shocked I did not think of cream could do that. I do use mostly Clinique products and have worked it into my routine, meaning this is not the only moisturizer from Clinique that I layer. It works very well in my routine, you might be able to get away with just using this moisturizer on its own, I live in a very dry desert climate so that's just not a possibility for me. Take advantage of the consultants that they have on their website to help you if you have questions.

I have fine lines on one side of my mouth and I have tried other wrinkle reducing moisturizers that helped but they were harsh on my skin. It felt like my skin was getting burnt and it would turn red. I also have very dry skin and in the summer combination skin. This product is going to be my keeper. It doesn't burn my skin, it makes it soft and silky, fine lines at my mouth are diminishing, does not make my skin oily, and does not burn it or cause redness. I highly recommend this product to anyone who cannot handle retinol and has sensitive skin.

extraits.titre: I am sticking with this moisturizer
extraits.texte: I love this moisturizer for aging skin. It makes skin brighter, soft, and silky. My fine lines at my mouth already look better. I had been using a retinoid based cream but it was burning my skin, not this stuff though. It's a bit pricey but I highly recommend it!

I bought this to help with early fine lines and ive been using for 6 months and can definitley tell a difference. It is very hydrating. I do switch this on and off with a retinol though, as this does not have any. Its very hydrating and the container has lasted me a good amount of time which is good since its so expensive. It lasts me about 2-3 months. I do have sensitive skin so when my skin is irritated or dry i cant use this and must use something gentler.
